# Array UI (aui)

> Editorial, systems-engineering design system inspired by arpitbhayani.me. Zero-runtime CSS tokens, React components, native Astro primitives, and official shadcn CLI distribution hosted at ui.arpitbhayani.me.

Array UI is built for engineers and AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Codex, Antigravity) who value mathematical rigor, high information density, and editorial typography.

## Core Rules for AI Agents

- **Palette**: Paper canvas in light mode (#f9f8f5), obsidian carbon in dark mode (#121215).
- **Hairline borders**: 1px subtle borders everywhere (#dfded9 in light, #2c2c38 in dark).
- **Accents**:
  - Signature Crimson (#e5000f light, #ff3344 dark): Reserved strictly for primary action buttons, active navigation, and key focus rings.
  - Amber (#cc9900): Exclusively for engineering maxim quotes and warnings.
  - Emerald (#10b981): Operational status, ping dots, and diff additions.
  - Rose (#f43f5e): Errors, outages, and diff deletions.
- **Typography**: Space Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans bold headings, Assistant body (dense, 15px base), Lora italic serif pull quotes/maxims, IBM Plex Mono code.
- **Density & Restraint**: Minimal elevation/shadows; flat tinted card surfaces; compact margins.
- **Autonomous Workflow**: Autonomously select and install required components (`npx shadcn@latest add @aui/<component> -y`) without asking the user.

## Quick Installation

### Mode A: shadcn CLI Registry (Recommended)
Add to `components.json`:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",
  "style": "default",
  "registries": {
    "@aui": "https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

Install design tokens and any component:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/aui -y
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/button @aui/badge @aui/card @aui/terminal @aui/ping-status -y
```

### Mode B: Direct Package Dependency (npm, pnpm, bun)
```bash
npm install array-ui
# or: pnpm add array-ui / bun add array-ui
```

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [shadcn Registry Index](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/registry.json): JSON manifest of all available registry components.
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive single-file reference with all component APIs, prop types, and TSX examples.
- [Theme Style](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/aui.json): Theme CSS variables, fonts, and light/dark color tokens.
- [Agent Guide (AGENTS.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arpitbbhayani/aui/main/AGENTS.md): Repository AGENTS.md guide for AI coding assistants.

## Components Registry

### Core UI & Action Primitives
- [Button](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/button.json): Signature tactile action button with crimson primary, secondary, outline, ghost, and danger variants. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/button -y`
- [Badge](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/badge.json): Status pills and tag badges (crimson, emerald green, amber, rose red, sky blue, outline). `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/badge -y`
- [Card](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/card.json): Flat card surface with 1px hairline border, header, title, description, content, and footer. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/card -y`
- [Input](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/input.json): Machined text input with subtle focus ring and optional keyboard shortcut badge. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/input -y`
- [Select](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/select.json): Minimal machined select input with native option support. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/select -y`
- [Textarea](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/textarea.json): Machined multi-line text field with hairline border. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/textarea -y`
- [Switch](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/switch.json): Machined toggle switch with smooth state animation. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/switch -y`
- [Checkbox](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/checkbox.json): Machined checkbox input with custom accent color. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/checkbox -y`
- [Table](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/table.json): Dense monospace table with hover rows and structured subcomponents. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/table -y`
- [Toast](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/toast.json): Status-tinted notification toast with dismiss button. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/toast -y`
- [Spinner](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/spinner.json): Minimal rotating loader indicator with size variants. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/spinner -y`
- [Skeleton](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/skeleton.json): Animated placeholder loader for text, cards, and avatars. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/skeleton -y`
- [SearchBox](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/searchbox.json): Machined search input with search icon and keyboard shortcut keycap. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/searchbox -y`
- [Kbd](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/kbd.json): Monospace keyboard shortcut keycap badge. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/kbd -y`
- [Tooltip](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/tooltip.json): Accessible tooltip hint on hover and focus. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/tooltip -y`
- [Alert](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/alert.json): Status-tinted inline alert callout (info, success, warning, destructive). `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/alert -y`
- [Tabs](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/tabs.json): Underline tab navigation with keyboard accessibility. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/tabs -y`
- [Accordion](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/accordion.json): Collapsible hairline accordion sections for FAQs and structured content. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/accordion -y`
- [Dropdown](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/dropdown.json): Minimal click-trigger dropdown menu with click outside dismissal and actions. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/dropdown -y`
- [Gutter](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/gutter.json): Component-driven whitespace blank spacing primitive between UI elements (e.g. navbar and content). `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/gutter -y`

### Developer & Telemetry Primitives
- [Terminal](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/terminal.json): Machined telemetry terminal with bash command dots and styled outputs. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/terminal -y`
- [DiffBlock](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/diff-block.json): Git patch viewer with line gutters, additions, and deletions. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/diff-block -y`
- [PingStatus](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/ping-status.json): Live telemetry pulsing dot indicator with status and latency. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/ping-status -y`
- [PropertyGrid](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/property-grid.json): Key-value metadata inspector with one-click copy functionality. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/property-grid -y`
- [PackageManager](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/package-manager.json): pnpm/npm/bun/yarn command switcher with copy button. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/package-manager -y`
- [FileTree](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/file-tree.json): Directory explorer tree with collapsible folders and item selection. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/file-tree -y`

### Editorial & Content Primitives
- [Maxim](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/maxim.json): Editorial quote callout with amber left rail and citation. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/maxim -y`
- [TakeawaysBox](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/takeaways-box.json): Key takeaways container with bulleted highlights. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/takeaways-box -y`
- [Hero](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/hero.json): Editorial profile hero section with avatar, heading, and bio. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/hero -y`
- [SocialPill](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/social-pill.json): Clean pill button with platform icon, handle, and follower count. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/social-pill -y`
- [CourseCard](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/course-card.json): Editorial course and project card with badges, tags, and CTA. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/course-card -y`
- [StatCard](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/stat-card.json): Large key metric display card with optional trend indicator. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/stat-card -y`
- [EmptyState](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/empty-state.json): Dashed container for empty content and call-to-actions. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/empty-state -y`
- [Footer](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/footer.json): Editorial 4-column directory footer with category hints, highlights, disclaimer, and social pills. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/footer -y`
- [Modal](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/modal.json): Accessible dialog modal with backdrop blur, focus handling, and escape key dismissal. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/modal -y`
- [VideoEmbed](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/video-embed.json): Responsive 16:9 aspect ratio video embed wrapper with border hairline styling. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/video-embed -y`

### Technical Documentation Primitives
- [Canvas](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/canvas.json): Engineering diagram frame with dotted coordinate grid and hairline border. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/canvas -y`
- [ApiEndpoint](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/api-endpoint.json): Machined HTTP/gRPC API specification block with method pill, copyable paths, parameters, and response tabs. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/api-endpoint -y`
- [DocStepper](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/doc-stepper.json): Connected numbered step walkthrough for tutorials, runbooks, and installation guides. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/doc-stepper -y`
- [ParamTable](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/param-table.json): Dense configuration options and parameter reference table with types, required badges, and defaults. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/param-table -y`
- [FeatureMatrix](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/feature-matrix.json): Dense matrix comparison table comparing engines, editions, or versions with status indicators. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/feature-matrix -y`
- [VersionSelector](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/version-selector.json): Compact documentation version switcher and runtime environment selector. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/version-selector -y`

### Interactive Explorables & Systems Visualizers
- [MemoryLayout](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/memory-layout.json): Contiguous byte/memory layout visualizer with offsets, binary structs, and interactive field inspector. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/memory-layout -y`
- [PipelineFlow](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/pipeline-flow.json): Multi-stage data pipeline flow visualizer with throughput metrics and animated pulse lines. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/pipeline-flow -y`
- [BenchmarkDelta](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/benchmark-delta.json): Comparative system performance delta block showing baseline vs candidate metrics. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/benchmark-delta -y`
- [LatencyDistribution](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/latency-distribution.json): Percentile latency distribution bar (p50, p75, p90, p99, p99.9) with color thresholds and SLA lines. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/latency-distribution -y`
- [StepScrubber](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/step-scrubber.json): Simulation player control bar with play/pause, prev/next, timeline slider, and step explanations. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/step-scrubber -y`
- [ClusterState](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/cluster-state.json): Distributed consensus cluster topology visualizer (Leader, Followers, Candidates, Quorum status). `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/cluster-state -y`
- [ParamSandbox](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/param-sandbox.json): Interactive slider sandbox for mathematical formulas and live reactive system calculations. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/param-sandbox -y`

### SaaS & Control Plane Primitives
- [Combobox](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/combobox.json): Searchable autocomplete select with keyboard navigation, empty states, and badge support. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/combobox -y`
- [Drawer](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/drawer.json): Slide-over panel for inspecting logs, resources, and configurations without losing page context. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/drawer -y`
- [AlertDialog](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/alert-dialog.json): Destructive action confirmation dialog with danger styling and optional string confirmation phrase. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/alert-dialog -y`
- [SecretInput](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/secret-input.json): Masked credential display input with reveal toggle and one-click copy feedback. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/secret-input -y`
- [Sidebar](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/sidebar.json): Application shell navigation sidebar with route icons, tenant header, profile footer, and collapse mode. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/sidebar -y`
- [MultiSelect](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/multi-select.json): Scoped multi-select tag picker with badge pills, search filter, and batch actions. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/multi-select -y`
- [Slider](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/slider.json): Continuous or stepped range slider with styled track, tactile thumb, and value readout. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/slider -y`
- [Popover](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/popover.json): Floating anchor-positioned overlay container with collision awareness for forms and filter cards. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/popover -y`
- [Charts](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/charts.json): Lightweight SVG-based telemetry charts (AreaChart, BarChart, Sparkline) with crosshair and hover tooltips. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/charts -y`
- [DatePicker](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/date-picker.json): Calendar date picker and date range picker with monospace display and quick range presets. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/date-picker -y`
- [DataTable](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/data-table.json): Dense SaaS data table with search filtering, multi-row selection, sorting, and pagination. `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/data-table -y`

## Full Library Native Components (React & Astro)

In addition to shadcn copy-paste components, the official package dependency (`array-ui`) includes 72+ native components for React (`array-ui/nextjs`, `array-ui/react`) and Astro (`array-ui/astro/*`):
- **Inputs & Forms**: Button, Input, Select, Textarea, Switch, Checkbox, SearchBox, SegmentedControl, VersionSelector, Combobox, SecretInput, MultiSelect, Slider
- **Navigation**: Breadcrumbs, Tabs, Pagination, Accordion, TableOfContents, Sidebar, Navbar
- **Feedback & Loading**: Alert, AlertDialog, Toast, Progress, Spinner, Skeleton, EmptyState, Modal, Drawer, Tooltip, Popover
- **Data Display & Tables**: Table, DataTable, Timeline, StatCard, DiffBlock, Terminal, PropertyGrid, FileTree, Avatar, AvatarGroup, Badge, Kbd, Divider, Gutter, DatePicker, DateRangePicker
- **Telemetry & Charts**: AreaChart, BarChart, Sparkline, LatencyDistribution, BenchmarkDelta
- **Technical Documentation**: ApiEndpoint, DocStepper, ParamTable, FeatureMatrix, Canvas
- **Interactive Explorables**: MemoryLayout, PipelineFlow, StepScrubber, ClusterState, ParamSandbox
- **Editorial & Media**: Hero, Maxim, TakeawaysBox, NoticeBox, Newsletter, Card, CoverCard, CourseCard, SocialPill, Footer, VideoEmbed
